'''Guy-Claude Burger''' ({{IPA|fr|ɡi.klod byʁ.ʒɛʁ|lang}}) (born September 4, 1934), is a French essayist known for creating a dietary practice called {{ill|instinct therapy|fr|instinctothérapie|}} which he exhibited in three separate works published between 1985 and 1990. He also espoused a theory of "metapsychoanalysis", described by the press as [[Pedophilia#Pedophile advocacy groups|pedophilia apologia]].

He came into conflict with the Swiss and French courts several times, cited in the French National Assembly's report ''Sects and Money'', indicating that he had been convicted for fraud and the [[illegal practice of medicine]] in 1997. He was also sentenced for fifteen years in December 2001 for the "rape of a minor under fifteen years of age".{{sfn|La République|2003}}<ref name=Parisien>{{cite news |date=8 February 2002 |title=Le == Biography ==
He played the cello for the Lausanne Conservatory and claimed to have a degree in physics and mathematics from the [[University of Lausanne]].<ref name=Lausanne>{{cite web |date=13 April 2007 |title=Risques D'Atteinte a L'Integrite Physique Encourus Par Les Adeptes de Sectes. |url=https://www.derives-sectes.gouv.fr/sites/default/files/editoriale/fichiers/these-medecine-armelle-guivier-2007%202.pdf |url-access= |trans-title=Risks of Damage to Physical Integrity Incurred by Followers of Cults |language=fr |location= |publisher=[[University of Franche-Comte]] |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220124170717/https://www.derives-sectes.gouv.fr/sites/default/files/editoriale/fichiers/these-medecine-armelle-guivier-2007%202.pdf#federation=archive.wikiwix.com&tab=url |archive-date=24 January 2022 |access-date=20 September 2025 |quote= }}</ref>

In 1958, while in Vevey, he was given a one-year suspended sentence for [[indecent assault]]. In 1960 at age 26, he was diagnosed with [[pharyngeal cancer|pharyngeal cancer (lymphomatous sarcoma)]]. He was treated with surgery and [[radiotherapy]], the later being an influence on his development of [[instinct therapy]].<ref name=radiotherapy>{{cite web |title=Thèse de médecine : Risques d'atteinte à l'intégrité physique encourus par les adeptes de sectes, Armelle Guivier, 2007 |url=http://www.miviludes.gouv.fr/RISQUES-D-ATTEINTE-A-L-INTEGRITE |url-access= |trans-title=Medical thesis: |access-date=20 September 2025 |quote= }}</ref> In 1964, he founded a company presenting itself as a food ecology center, naming it [[Éclépens]].<ref name=Eclepans>{{cite news |date= |title=Justice : |archive-date=20 September 2025 |access-date=20 September 2025 |quote= }}</ref> After his release, he departed for Mexico in 1981, describing it as an "escape"<ref name=escape>{{cite news |date= In 1984, he founded the {{ill|Center of Instinct Therapy|fr|Center d'instinct therapy}} at {{ill|Castle Montramé|fr|château de Montramé}} in [[Soisy-Bouy]], southeast of Paris. In 1985, he wrote the book ''The Local War, Instinct Therapy''. He was arrested for illegally practicing medicine in 1987 and was prohibited from returning to Montrame and practicing instinct therapy in France. After being released, he settled in Provins, close to Montramé. In April 1989, he appeared on the show {{lang|fr|[[Ciel, mon mardi !]]}} hosted by Christophe Dechavanne.<ref name=Christophe>{{cite news |date= |title=Émission "Ciel Mon Mardi" de Patrick Dechavanne |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A4GZIhwNLyM?t=45&gl=FR |url-access= |trans-title=Patrick Dechavanne's "Ciel Mon Mardi" show |work= |language= |location= |publisher= |url-status=dead |access-date=20 September 2025 |via= |quote= }}{{dead link|date=September 2025|fix-attempted=yes}}</ref>

In 1990, he published ''Instinct Therapy, Eating Real'' through [[Éditions du Rocher]]. In 1995, the International Federation for the Development of Instinctive Eating (FIDALI), founded by Guy-Claude Burger,<ref name=FIDALI>{{cite web |date=1997 |title=Bulletin de liaison du CCMM demars |archive-date=2 February 2023 |access-date=20 September 2025 |url-status=bot: unknown }}</ref>

In December 2001, he was placed in "criminal imprisonment" for the "rape of a minor under fifteen years of age".{{sfn|Santucci|2001}}{{sfn|Festraëts|2001}}<ref name=years>{{cite news |date=10 December 2001 |title=La victoire d'Audre et les victimes de Montram |url=http://www.larepublique77.fr/news/archivestory.php/aid/3326/La_victoire_d%92Audrey_et_des_victimes_de_Montram%E9.html |url-access= |trans-title=The victory of Audre and the victims of Montram |work={{ill|La République de Seine-et-Marne|fr}} |language=fr |location= |url-status=dead |access-date= |quote= }}{{dead link|date=September 2025}}</ref> His sentence was confirmed on appeal in 2003, then confirmed by the [[Court of Cassation]], the highest court in France, in May 2004.<ref name=May>{{cite news |title=Le pourvoi en cassation de Burger rejeté |url=https://www.leparisien.fr/seine-et-marne-77/-14-05-2004-2004981478.php |trans-title=Burger's appeal dismissed |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/index2.php?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.leparisien.fr%2Fseine-et-marne%2F-14-05-2004-2004981478.php |archive-date=12 Apr 2018}}{{dead link|date=September 2025}}</ref>

== Theories ==
=== Instinct therapy ===
Instinct therapy is a practice that emphasizes a raw food-diet based on Burger's hypothesis of incomplete genetic adaptation to changes undergone by human diet since [[prehistory]]. In practice, these meals consist of "original foods", i.e. raw and not seasoned or mixed, which is chosen according to variations in perceptions of smell, taste and repletion. Animal milks and some cereals are excluded.

Burger claims that this method can treat several illnesses, including [[cancer]] and [[AIDS]]. There are no current clinical studies on instinct theory.

=== Metapsychoanalysis ===
According to Burger's claims, the goal of human sexuality is not limited to reproduction and pleasure. He postulates that sexuality in accordance with instinct, without respect to "patterns dictated by society" (notably on adult-child relationships", this would help resolve many of society's issues and allow the development of extra-sensory faculties such as clairvoyance and telepathy. This is all developed under his theory "metapsychoanalysis".<ref name=metapsych>{{cite news |date= |title=Qu'est-ce que la métapsychanalyse ? |url=https://sites.google.com/site/metapsychanalyse/home/qu-est-ce-que-la-metapsychanalyse |trans-title=What is metapsychanalysis? |language=fr |url-status=bot: unknown |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250915045853/https://sites.google.com/site/metapsychanalyse/home/qu-est-ce-que-la-metapsychanalyse#federation=archive.wikiwix.com&tab=url |archive-date=15 September 2025 |access-date =20 September 2025}}</ref> This theory has been described by news agencies as "an apology for pedophilia packed in pseudoscientific gibberish."{{sfn|Festraëts|2001}}

After having been convicted in Switzerland in 1978 for "indecent assault and unnatural practices on children,"<ref name=Switzerland>{{cite news |date= |title=instinctothérapie - Orkos. |url=https://www.prevensectes.me/instinc.htm |trans-title=Instinct therapy - Orkos. |language=fr |location= |publisher= |url-status=bot: unknown |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250720192342/https://www.prevensectes.me/instinc.htm#federation=archive.wikiwix.com&tab=url |archive-date=20 July 2025 |access-date=20 September 2025}}</ref> including his own son,<ref name=son>{{cite news |date=9 November 2008 |title=La cavale du fils du gourou s'achève à Bali |url=https://www.leparisien.fr/faits-divers/la-cavale-du-fils-du-gourou-s-acheve-a-bali-09-11-2008-304311.php |trans-title=The run of the guru's son ends in Bali |language=fr |publisher=[[Le Parisien]] |url-status=bot: unknown |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123023400/https://www.leparisien.fr/faits-divers/la-cavale-du-fils-du-gourou-s-acheve-a-bali-09-11-2008-304311.php#federation=archive.wikiwix.com&tab=url |archive-date=23 January 2025 |access-date=20 September 2025}}</ref> he was again convicted in 2001 and was sentenced to fifteen years in prison for the "rape of a 15-year-old minor by a person in authority, corruption of minors and repeated death threats",{{sfn|La République|2003}} which Burger has denied. His son was also prosecuted for sexual assault and abuse of minors.<ref name=son></ref>

During his trial, Burger explained his research into children's sexual instincts: "It is difficult for children to speak about their sexuality without experiencing it. Children have impulses, and I think we should let children come to the adult when they ask. I wanted to check if impulses were genetically programmed and what the purpose of their sexual instincts were."<ref name=instincts>{{cite news |url=http://www.larepublique77.fr/news/fullstory.php/aid/3242/Le_chef_de_la_communaut_E9_de_Montram_E9_accus_E9_de_viols_sur_mineurs.html |title=Le chef de la communauté de Montramé accusé de viols sur mineurs |trans-title=Montramé community leader accused of rape of minors |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/index2.php?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.larepublique.com%2Fnews%2Ffullstory.php%2Faid%2F3242%2FLe_chef_de_la_communaut_E9_de_Montram_E9_accus_E9_de_viols_sur_mineurs.html#federation=archive.wikiwix.com&tab=url |archive-date=23 Feb 2011 |quote=}}{{dead link|date=September 2025}}</ref>
